purpose: 크로스링구얼 대조군. 골든셋(`golden-set.json` v2.0)의 한국어 질의 30건을 영어로 옮긴 것이며, 검색 프로브(`scripts/probe_retrieval.py`)에서만 쓴다. 파이프라인은 이 파일을 읽지 않는다.

provenance.note: ⚠️ session-05(ADR-005 Amendment)에서 쓴 번역본은 **저장되지 않았다.** GS-001~009는 session-12에서 다시 작성한 것이며 이번 세션에서 **한 글자도 바꾸지 않았다** — 바꾸면 session-12와의 비교가 다시 깨진다. GS-010~030은 이번 세션에서 신규 작성했다.
provenance.principle: 질의의 의미만 옮긴다. 기대 문서 초록의 어휘를 그대로 쓰면 어휘 일치로 유리해져 측정이 무의미해진다 (ADR-005 Amendment §2). 예: GS-020은 초록의 'asynchronous'를 피하지 않되 'long-horizon asynchronous scenarios'라는 구절 자체를 베끼지 않았고, GS-025는 'infeasible in single-turn settings'를 'impossible in one request'로 바꿔 썼다.
provenance.comparability: **GS-001~009 구간만이 session-12와 동일 조건의 재현이다.** GS-010~030은 이번 회차가 최초 측정이므로 비교 대상이 없다.

queries.GS-001: What difficulties are reported when designing and evaluating LLM multi-agent collaboration systems?
queries.GS-002: How does the choice of architecture in a multi-agent LLM framework affect system performance?
queries.GS-003: Is there research that applies LLM-based multi-agent systems to the manufacturing floor?
queries.GS-004: Is there an approach that adjusts the alignment of an LLM agent without retraining it?
queries.GS-005: Is there a framework that applies multi-agent LLMs to financial trading?
queries.GS-006: Is there an approach that uses a multi-agent structure to evaluate the performance of an LLM?
queries.GS-007: Are there cases where LLM multi-agents reasoned autonomously in automating scientific research?
queries.GS-008: What requirements must be met when processing pseudonymized data under Korea's Personal Information Protection Act?
queries.GS-009: Are there measured numbers for how much GPU cost can be saved when operating an LLM multi-agent system?
queries.GS-010: Is there a study measuring how well two language models can narrow down candidates by exchanging questions and answers?
queries.GS-011: Is there research on spotting a model's reward-cheating behaviour from its internal representations?
queries.GS-012: For tokenisers, which matters more for language model performance -- what is optimised, or how it is searched?
queries.GS-013: Is there a benchmark that evaluates vision-language models on understanding artworks in an educational setting?
queries.GS-014: Is there an account of AI hardware shifting its focus from large-scale training toward meeting inference demand?
queries.GS-015: Has anyone surveyed how much agent benchmark papers reveal about the conditions their evaluations were run under?
queries.GS-016: Is there an approach that converts scientific code repositories into runnable environments an agent can learn from?
queries.GS-017: Is there a way to align a model using only comparisons, without computing gradients, when preference pairs differ only slightly?
queries.GS-018: Is there research showing that scores for radiology report generation models shift with how the reference reports were written?
queries.GS-019: Is there a study that splits a small model into planning, calling and summarising roles to improve tool use?
queries.GS-020: Is there a benchmark measuring how well agents plan long tasks asynchronously when steps run in parallel or get interrupted?
queries.GS-021: Is there research on linking each phrase of an image caption to pixel-level masks?
queries.GS-022: Is there a framework that improves a coding agent's search strategy by trying it against records of past attempts?
queries.GS-023: Has anyone laid out an operating scheme for tracking, investigating and disclosing cases of model misalignment?
queries.GS-024: Is a feature being tested where clicking an ad opens a conversation with a company-sponsored agent?
queries.GS-025: Is there a benchmark measuring vulnerability to attacks that reach goals impossible in one request by exchanging many turns with an agent?
queries.GS-026: Are there performance numbers from a Korean company fine-tuning a Korean-language LLM on its own internal documents?
queries.GS-027: Have safety incidents been reported from attaching LLM agents to real factory equipment?
queries.GS-028: Is there an experiment that varies inference server settings such as batch size or KV cache and measures throughput?
queries.GS-029: Are there results showing an LLM agent beating specialist physicians' diagnostic accuracy in a clinical trial?
queries.GS-030: Is there research measuring the power consumption or carbon emissions of running a multi-agent system?
